name: The Price Tag
description: Give every power, technology, or custom a cost and find out who pays it.
key_questions: What does this cost each time it is used?|Who pays when the user cannot?|What happens to people who refuse to pay?

name: Who Cleans Up
description: Follow the side effects of the world's big systems down to the people who deal with them.
key_questions: What mess does this leave behind?|Whose job is cleaning it up?|What do those people know that the powerful do not?

name: What Is Illegal Here
description: Find the laws and taboos that reveal what this world fears.
key_questions: What gets you arrested, exiled, or shunned?|Why was it banned?|Who breaks the rule anyway, and how?

name: A Day for the Lowest Paid
description: Walk through one ordinary day of the person at the bottom of this world.
key_questions: Where do they wake up?|What do they eat and who do they owe?|What would they never say aloud?

name: The Market Stall
description: Stand at a market and list what is sold, what is scarce, and what is haggled over.
key_questions: What is cheap here that is precious elsewhere?|What can you not buy at any price?|What is sold under the counter?

name: Curses and Holidays
description: Invent how people swear and what they celebrate; both show what they hold sacred.
key_questions: What do people swear by, or at?|What is the biggest holiday and what does it remember?|Which celebration is quietly resented?

name: The Rumor Mill
description: Write three rumors each faction spreads about the others, true or not.
key_questions: What does each faction say about its rivals?|Which rumor is true?|Who started the one that is not?

name: Edge of the Map
description: Name what lies past the known edge and what people believe about it.
key_questions: What is beyond the last map?|What do people believe is out there?|Who came back, and what did they refuse to describe?
